settings: at the edge of a forest
constraints: use negative space as a key shape
flaws: cannot let go of old grudges
secrets: knows why a local landmark disappeared
has been receiving letters from someone believed dead
caused the accident everyone blames on someone else
is secretly planning to leave town
owns an object that should not exist
stakes: their family home will be lost
the town will discover what they hid
someone innocent will take the blame
they will lose the only person who trusts them
a dangerous secret will become public
the mission will strand everyone far from home
twists: the antagonist is trying to prevent something worse
the missing person left on purpose
the map is accurate, but for a different century
the object everyone wants is a decoy
the protagonist caused the problem years ago
the safest place is the one everyone fears
the apparent coincidence was carefully staged
roleplay_settings: a storm shelter during a citywide blackout
a village festival where neither character belongs
a crowded airport after every flight is canceled
a bookstore during an unexpected lock-in
a royal banquet just before a scandal breaks
a roadside motel in heavy rain
a starship with one working escape pod
roleplay_goals: convince the other person to stay
hide the truth long enough to finish the task
retrieve an item without admitting why it matters
get an apology without asking for one
decide who should take the risk
work together despite a recent betrayal
find out what the other person really knows
make a deal before time runs out
opening_lines: “If we miss this chance, there won't be another one.”
“I can explain, but you won't like the explanation.”
“We have ten minutes before they come back.”
“I need you to trust me for exactly five minutes.”
